sources.snippet: To run Qwen3.8-27B-TURBO-Fable-Cold-Fusion-735-882-Heretic-Uncensored-NM-DAU for inference at FP16, you need roughly 61 GB of VRAM. The cheapest fit on Spheron is A100 80GB at about $1.43/hr. Quantize to INT4 to run it on a smaller, cheaper GPU.
